edits.value_json: 四 means “four.” Its current form visibly encloses 儿-form strokes within 囗. The distinct graph 亖 directly represented four and coexisted with forms written 四. Some 四 forms are interpreted as counting rods; other proposals say 四 was borrowed from a breath-related graph associated with 呬, or from a graph for 泗 (“nasal discharge”). The 泗 proposal lacks textual attestation; neither borrowing account is established.
